text:
Skylar (Product): quick sync — we need cross-team alignment on the 'Launch Rally' pilot for AcmeCorp. customer ask: private pilot with burst capacity + HSM-backed keys. can we map deps and firm up launch criteria?
Priya (PM): goals: 1) pilot customers onboarded 2) SLOs met (p95 latency <= 220ms for gen requests) 3) acceptable cost envelope for private mode. needs timeline by EOD Fri.
Mateo (Eng Runtime): runtime work: quant profile + cold-start KV cache warmup. rough estimate: 2 sprints for integration tests + perf tuning.
Chen (Infra): infra items: VPC peering, reserved GPU slots, and KMS/HSM network paths. need security signoff for HSM routing.
Ayesha (Security): HSM path + key rotation policy required. also need threat model review for private control plane. can do review next Tue.
Jordan (SRE): can support prewarm/burst plan. questions: what burst QPS and expected sustained qps? also, monitoring/alerting hooks required.
Nora (Solutions): customer expects end-to-end onramp docs + a checklist. we need clear acceptance criteria so onboarding doesn't stall.
Skylar (Product): good. propose we list launch gating items in one place and assign owners. quick draft below — feel free to edit: 
```
Gates (must pass):
- Security signoff on HSM/networking (owner: Ayesha)
- VPC and routing validated (owner: Chen)
- Runtime perf: p95 <= 220ms on pilot workload (owner: Mateo)
- Burst capacity validated (sustained 2m at 10k RPS for 30s) (owner: Jordan)
- Onboarding checklist and playbook completed (owner: Nora)
- Canaries and rollback plan + metrics (owner: Priya)
```
Mateo (Eng Runtime): couple notes: that burst item looks high for a private pilot. can we define realistic pilot targets: burst 500 RPS upstream => internal tokens/sec?
Priya (PM): fair. customer asked for 'burst' but not 10k. change to "pilot burst: 500 RPS for 60s"? we can escalate later for prod.
Jordan (SRE): 500 RPS for 60s seems doable if we reserve capacity. will need autoscaler policy change and prewarm hook. I can prototype policy in a day.
Chen (Infra): need the subnet/CIDR details from AcmeCorp to validate peering. @Nora can you get that? also certs for control-plane TLS.
Nora (Solutions): yep, asking Acme now. ETA tomorrow morning. will share CIDR and cert requirements.
Ayesha (Security): add to gates: key storage and access audit enabled (owner: Ayesha). also require that control-plane logs scrub PII by default.
Skylar (Product): updated gate list in-place; also add launch timeline target: pilot start window = 3 weeks from now. is that realistic?
Mateo (Eng Runtime): 3 weeks is tight but possible if we parallelize runtime perf + infra. need 1 additional runtime engineer for 2 weeks to hit perf target.
Chen (Infra): infra needs: ETA for CIDR + certs, and confirmation on GPU reservations. once Nora shares CIDR, I can confirm by EOD tomorrow.
Priya (PM): decision point: assign extra runtime headcount (2-week contractor) — @Skylar can you approve?
Skylar (Product): tentatively yes, allocate from the launch pool. I'll confirm by EOD.
Jordan (SRE): monitoring list: latency p50/p95/p99, error rate, queue depth, cache hit ratio, kms call latency. will prepare dashboards and alerts.
Nora (Solutions): onboarding checklist draft: creds, VPC instructions, cert exchange flow, smoke test steps, rollback steps. will post in this thread once done.
Mateo (Eng Runtime): quick config snippet for runtime warmup I want to test: 
```yaml
warmup:
  prefetch_prefixes: 5
  kv_cache_retention: 120s
  batch_size_target: 32
```
Priya (PM): acceptance criteria proposal (short): 
- Pilot deployed to Acme's VPC with working key access
- Perf: median latency comparable to hosted baseline, p95 <= 220ms
- Onboarding: customer completes smoke test without manual ops escalations
- Ops: dashboards + alerts live + runbook present
Ayesha (Security): also require vulnerability scan and threat model signoff before pilot begins.
Skylar (Product): summarize action items + owners: 
- Ayesha: security signoff + key audit (due: Tue)
- Chen: VPC peering + certs validation (due: tomorrow EOD)
- Mate o: runtime perf + warmup config (PR by Wed)
- Jordan: dashboards & autoscaler policy (first draft Wed)
- Nora: gather Acme CIDR/certs + onboarding draft (tomorrow morning)
- Skylar: approve contractor + finalize timeline (EOD)
Priya (PM): can everyone react with :thumbsup: if they agree to the owners/dates, or call out blockers now.
DeployBot: scheduled check-in reminder set for 1719995000 (in 1h) :bell:
Chen (Infra): :thumbsup:
Mateo (Eng Runtime): :thumbsup:
Ayesha (Security): :thumbsup: but will need a short sync block with Chen on HSM network flows.
Jordan (SRE): :thumbsup:
Nora (Solutions): :thumbsup:
Skylar (Product): thanks — I'll post final timeline after contractor approval. small follow-up: Priya, can you own the rollback playbook?
Priya (PM): yes, will draft rollback steps and merge with Nora's onboarding doc.
Skylar (Product): great. we'll reconvene in this thread. if any blocker surfaces ping me directly. :rocket:
